title: Ronaldo Career Quiz
description: Start with the defining clubs, milestones, and achievements of Ronaldo's career.

questions.question: Which club did Cristiano Ronaldo play for immediately before joining Manchester United in 2003?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo made his senior breakthrough at Sporting CP in Portugal before moving to Manchester United in 2003.

questions.question: In which year did Ronaldo join Real Madrid?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo joined Real Madrid in 2009 after six seasons with Manchester United.

questions.question: Which national team does Ronaldo represent?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo has represented Portugal at senior international level since 2003.

questions.question: Which major international tournament did Portugal win in 2016?
questions.explanation: Portugal won UEFA Euro 2016, defeating France in the final.

questions.question: In which year did Ronaldo win his first Ballon d'Or?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo won his first Ballon d'Or in 2008 following a prolific season with Manchester United.

questions.question: How many UEFA Champions League titles has Cristiano Ronaldo won?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo has won five UEFA Champions League titles: one with Manchester United and four with Real Madrid.

questions.question: What jersey number did Ronaldo wear during his first senior season at Sporting CP, before taking over the famous number 7?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo wore number 28 at Sporting CP before receiving number 7 at Manchester United.

questions.question: Which U.S. President was Cristiano Ronaldo named after?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo was named after Ronald Reagan, who was an actor before becoming U.S. President.

questions.question: What is Cristiano Ronaldo's dominant foot?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo is predominantly right-footed, although he is also highly capable with his left.

questions.question: How many Premier League titles did Ronaldo win?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo won three Premier League titles with Manchester United: 2006–07, 2007–08, and 2008–09.

title: Ronaldo at Real Madrid
description: Test your knowledge of the most prolific chapter of Ronaldo's club career.

questions.question: Which shirt number did Ronaldo famously wear at Real Madrid?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo wore the number 7 shirt at Real Madrid, continuing the CR7 identity associated with his career.

questions.question: Which club did Real Madrid defeat in the 2014 UEFA Champions League final?
questions.explanation: Real Madrid defeated city rivals Atlético Madrid 4–1 after extra time in the 2014 final.

questions.question: Against which German club did Ronaldo score a hat-trick in the 2017 Champions League quarter-final second leg?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo scored a hat-trick against Bayern Munich in the second leg of the 2016–17 quarter-final.

questions.question: Which manager coached Real Madrid when Ronaldo won the 2016–17 Champions League with the club?
questions.explanation: Zinedine Zidane managed Real Madrid to the 2016–17 Champions League title.

questions.question: Which Italian club did Ronaldo join after leaving Real Madrid in 2018?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo moved from Real Madrid to Juventus in the summer of 2018.

questions.question: How old was Cristiano Ronaldo when he joined Real Madrid?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo was 24 when he joined Real Madrid from Manchester United in the summer of 2009.

questions.question: What was the name of the iconic attacking trio Ronaldo formed at Real Madrid in his later years?
questions.explanation: The BBC trio consisted of Gareth Bale, Karim Benzema, and Cristiano Ronaldo.

questions.question: How many hat-tricks did Ronaldo score in La Liga?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo scored 34 La Liga hat-tricks during his time with Real Madrid.

questions.question: Against whom did Ronaldo score his first official goal for Real Madrid?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo scored his first official Real Madrid goal from the penalty spot against Deportivo La Coruña on 29 August 2009.

questions.question: How many UEFA Champions League goals did Ronaldo score for Real Madrid?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo scored 105 UEFA Champions League goals for Real Madrid.

title: Ronaldo's Champions League Career
description: Test your knowledge of Ronaldo's records, goals, and defining moments in Europe's biggest club competition.

questions.question: How many goals did Cristiano Ronaldo score in the UEFA Champions League?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo finished his Champions League career with 140 goals, making him the competition's all-time leading scorer.

questions.question: How many times did Ronaldo win the UEFA Champions League?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo won the Champions League five times: once with Manchester United and four times with Real Madrid.

questions.question: How many Champions League goals did Ronaldo score in the knockout stages?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo scored 67 goals in the Champions League knockout stages, a competition record.

questions.question: How many goals did Ronaldo score in UEFA Champions League finals?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo scored four goals in Champions League finals, including one for Manchester United and three for Real Madrid.

questions.question: Against which club did Ronaldo score his award-winning free kick to claim the 2009 FIFA Puskás Award?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo won the inaugural FIFA Puskás Award for his long-range free kick against Porto in the 2009 Champions League quarter-final.

questions.question: In which knockout round did Ronaldo score his famous bicycle kick against Juventus in 2018?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo's spectacular bicycle kick came in the first leg of Real Madrid's 2017–18 Champions League quarter-final against Juventus.

questions.question: After scoring a hat-trick against Bayern Munich in the 2017 quarter-finals, which team did Ronaldo score another knockout-stage hat-trick against in the next round?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo followed his hat-trick against Bayern Munich with another against Atlético Madrid in the 2016–17 semi-final first leg.

questions.question: How many times did Ronaldo finish a Champions League season as the competition's top scorer?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo finished as the Champions League's top scorer in seven different seasons.

questions.question: Which club has Ronaldo scored the most Champions League goals against?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo scored 10 Champions League goals against Juventus, more than against any other opponent.

questions.question: How many goals did Ronaldo score in the 2013–14 Champions League season, setting a single-season record?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo scored a record 17 goals in the 2013–14 Champions League campaign as Real Madrid won La Décima.
